classes.name: ActionWorkLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned deep module whose interface owns runtime Action Work listing, claim, heartbeat, acknowledgement, parking, claim-event reporting, receipt harvest, audit recording, and storage-error classification.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates and authorizes Action Work callers, maps protocol messages, and delegates durable lifecycle behavior to the Action Work lifecycle module.

classes.name: ActionWork
classes.description: Runtime-dispatch work materialized as an ActionInstance effect and advanced by generation-fenced host claims, heartbeats, terminal acknowledgements, parking, and continuation events.

classes.name: ActionWorkPersistenceAdapter
classes.description: SQLite or PostgreSQL persistence adapter exposed through RuntimeDb for Action Work effects, parks, continuations, claim events, operation receipts, and audit decisions.

relations.name: delegates_action_work_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates Action Work listing, claim, heartbeat, acknowledgement, parking, event reporting, receipt harvest, audit, and error classification to the Action Work lifecycle module.

relations.name: governs_action_work
relations.description: The Action Work lifecycle module governs durable host claim and acknowledgement transitions for Action Work.

relations.name: uses_action_work_persistence_adapter
relations.description: The Action Work lifecycle module uses the RuntimeDb persistence adapter seam for SQLite and PostgreSQL Action Work storage.
